_meta.openai/toolInvocation/invoking: Auditing titles, descriptions and alt text...

description:
Best for: "which products have no alt text?", "are any descriptions copied?" or "which descriptions are too thin?".
Returns: four lists, up to 100 entries each: no_alt (images without alt text), duplicate_descriptions, thin_descriptions and title_issues, with totals before the cut.
Input tips: send exactly one of csv (a Shopify product CSV) or domain (a store address such as example.com); optional min_words, the word count below which a description is thin (default 20). Domain mode reads the public product feed once, after robots.txt. Errors: both_given, missing_source, csv_too_large, or a feed refusal; then ask for the CSV.
Not for: writing the fixes (use listing_fix_sheet), GTINs or Merchant Center rules (use merchant_feed_check).

csv.description: The full text of a Shopify product CSV, header row first, such as "Title,URL handle,Description,Vendor,Price,...". Paste the file exported from Shopify admin (Products > Export) as it is. At most 2 MB; split a larger file by rows and repeat the header in each part. Example call: {"csv": "Title,URL handle,Price\nWool Beanie,wool-beanie,24.00"}

domain.description: A store address such as example.com, sent instead of csv (send exactly one of the two). The store's public /products.json is read once (at most 5 pages of 250 products), after its robots.txt. Large stores often block it; then ask the user for the CSV. Example call: {"domain": "example.com"}

min_words.description: A description with fewer words than this counts as thin, such as 30. Default 20.

name: listing_text_audit

duplicate_descriptions.description: Descriptions of 5 or more words shared by several products, at most 100 groups

excerpt.description: The first 80 characters of the shared description

handles.description: URL handles of the products that share it

feed_truncated.description: Present and true when the store has more products than the 5 pages read

host.description: The store host that was read, in domain mode only

no_alt.description: Images with empty alt text, at most 100

handle.description: The product's URL handle (the item id for a Google Merchant feed file)

position.description: The image's position in the product gallery, from 1; null when the source gives none

row.description: Spreadsheet row of the image, header is row 1; 0 in domain mode

source.description: Where the products came from: the csv text or the store's public feed (domain)

thin_descriptions.description: Products whose description has fewer words than min_words, at most 100

handle.description: The product's URL handle (the item id for a Google Merchant feed file)

words.description: Words in the description; 0 when it is empty

title_issues.description: One entry per product and title problem, at most 100

handle.description: The product's URL handle (the item id for a Google Merchant feed file)

problem.description: One of: empty title, extra whitespace, longer than 150 characters, all capitals, promotional text, very short (under 10 characters)

totals.description: Counts before each list was cut to 100

truncated.description: True when any list had more than 100 entries

title: Audit product listing text
